frequency_question: How often do national-level union federations proceed with an indefinite industry-wide strike within the designated notice window after reaching a deadlock?
membership_rule: Includes any formally announced industry-wide indefinite strike threat by major national union coalitions in heavily unionised sectors with statutory conciliation mechanisms. Excludes localized or single-enterprise strikes.
window: A 46-day operational window following formal notice or deadlock declaration

cases.name: National public sector federation strike threat 2021
All-India state sector union strike notice 2023

coverage_note: 5 named historical instances of major national federation strike threats in comparable regulatory environments; believed to represent the primary set of well-tracked sector-level federation escalations over the recent baseline period.
known_gaps: Excludes minor unofficial walkouts and uncoordinated regional actions by sub-federations.
validity_reason: Labor laws, conciliation frameworks, and national union federation bargaining structures evolve slowly over decades.
